email.subject1: a signal play for Gorilla Logic
email.body1:
Beth, reaching out because demand for nearshore is climbing and Gorilla Logic is scaling 700+ engineers across Costa Rica, Colombia, and Mexico.

When delivery capacity grows like that, sales usually has more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Gorilla Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Beth, quick follow-up for Gorilla Logic.

When capacity scales, sales has to fill it, but most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to keep the bench busy. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Gorilla Logic needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Beth, last bit of proof for Gorilla Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Gorilla Logic's reply rate likely compares to other software-services teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Beth, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling delivery capacity is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a nearshore services motion? I will tailor it to Gorilla Logic either way.
